These Hotlists shall be sent to all 21 CS Flight Leads and Senior Leadership. This notification email will include all pertinent data on all currently open High Priority tickets and information on any other applicable high visibility projects or concerns. Hands on training from CFP technicians concerning the exact process used to present the relevant Hotlist data will be provided from current CFP government employees during the 90-day military-to- contractor turnover period. Compilation of Ticket Data The contractor will perform a once-weekly task known as “Running the Numbers”, an action performed on both NIPRNET and SIPRNET using Remedy which exports data into Microsoft Excel.
